sources.title: SOF National Science Olympiad Class 2 Sample Paper 2016-17
sources.notes: Reviewed official legacy Class 2 sample. Its useful facts/skills overlap already-evidenced ranking, skin/touch, cousin, flower/seed, cotton/fibre, planet-order and family-tree themes, while remaining items do not exactly support currently pending canonical rows. Registered to prevent repeated rediscovery; adds zero new exact row anchors.

sources.title: SOF National Science Olympiad Class 2 Sample Paper 2015-16
sources.notes: Reviewed official legacy Class 2 sample. Its science/reasoning items substantially overlap later official samples. Near-matches such as a three-state repeating figure sequence and generic air-property statements are not promoted to narrower pending canonical rows. Registered to prevent rediscovery; adds zero new exact row anchors.

sources.title: SOF National Science Olympiad Class 2 Sample Paper 2014-15
sources.notes: Reviewed official legacy Class 2 sample. Useful NSO items repeat already-evidenced skin/touch, cousin, flower/seed, cotton/fibre and planet-order themes; the monsoon-season image and cycle item do not exactly prove the pending rainwear or bicycle-pedal rows. Registered to prevent rediscovery; adds zero new exact row anchors.

sources.title: SOF National Science Olympiad Class 2 Sample Paper 2013-14
sources.notes: Reviewed official legacy Class 2 sample. Inspectable NSO items repeat already-evidenced skin/touch, cousin, flower/seed, cotton/fibre and planet-order themes. Its cycle item proves only no-engine/not-animal-pulled, not the narrower canonical bicycle-pedal fact; the season figure does not exactly prove current rainwear rows. Registered to prevent rediscovery; adds zero new exact row anchors.

sources.title: SOF National Science Olympiad Level-II Class 2 Sample Paper (undated legacy)
sources.notes: Official SOF-hosted legacy Level-II Class 2 sample reviewed during the exact-evidence pass. The artifact has no named academic year, so it cannot satisfy historical_class2 row evidence. Its inspectable science items do not exactly support currently pending canonical rows; registered to prevent rediscovery and adds zero exact anchors.

sources.title: SOF National Science Olympiad Class 2 Sample Paper (legacy undated Class-2_7)
sources.notes: Official SOF-hosted legacy Class 2 sample. It contains an inspectable lungs-help-breathing item matching canonical kr.human.lungs.function.breathe, but the artifact exposes no named academic year. The historical_class2 contract therefore forbids promoting that row from this source until the year is established reproducibly. Other useful items are redundant or not exact canonical matches. Adds zero exact anchors.
